madurai.name: మధురై
madurai.description: ఉదయం 4:00 మీనాక్షి అమ్మన్ దర్శనం నుండి పూల వీధులు, నాయక్కర్ మహల్ మరియు వైగై సాయంత్రం వరకు.

kumbakonam.name: కుంభకోణం
kumbakonam.description: ప్రాచీన శివ-విష్ణు ఆలయాలు, ఇత్తడి హస్తకళా వీధులు, డిగ్రీ కాఫీ, మహామహం కొలను మరియు కావేరి ఘాట్లు.
kumbakonam.highlights: మహామహం కొలను · చోళ కంచు · కావేరి ఘాట్లు

visitorTips.title: Visitor Etiquette & Travel Tips
visitorTips.subtitle: Helpful cultural guidance for international guests in Tamil Nadu.
visitorTips.dressCodeBody: Cover shoulders and knees (long trousers, skirts, sarees, or kurtas). Avoid shorts or sleeveless tops inside sanctums.
visitorTips.shoesBody: Leave shoes at designated temple stands (small ₹5–₹10 token) before entering stone courtyards; cotton socks help on warm granite.
visitorTips.photoBody: Cameras and phones are permitted in outer courtyards with a modest fee at select sites, but strictly prohibited inside inner sanctums.
visitorTips.bargainingBody: In local bazaars, a friendly smile and 10–15% negotiation is normal; avoid aggressive haggling with small women-run flower or craft stalls.
visitorTips.safetyBody: Carry bottled water, sun protection after 10 AM, and confirm metered/package auto fares inside Wingo before boarding.

mdu-meenakshi.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
mdu-meenakshi.summary: 2,500-year-old Dravidian marvel with 14 painted gopurams and the Hall of a Thousand Pillars.
mdu-meenakshi.darshanInfo: 4:00 AM Viswaroopa Darshan; phones/bags deposited at East/South locker counters.
mdu-meenakshi.dressCode: Modest attire covering shoulders and knees; no shorts or leather belts inside.
mdu-meenakshi.feeNote: Free general darshan; ₹100 special darshan & museum extra (verify before launch).

mdu-thiruparankundram-temple.name: Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple
mdu-thiruparankundram-temple.summary: First of the six Arupadaiveedu rock-cut shrines of Lord Murugan carved into granite.
mdu-thiruparankundram-temple.darshanInfo: Morning Abhishekam around 6:30 AM; calm rock-cut sanctum atmosphere.
mdu-thiruparankundram-temple.dressCode: Traditional or modest attire; footwear left at foothills counter.
mdu-thiruparankundram-temple.feeNote: Free entry; optional special archana ticket at counter.

mdu-koodal-azhagar.name: Koodal Azhagar Perumal Temple
mdu-koodal-azhagar.summary: Rare three-tiered Vaishnava shrine depicting seated, standing, and reclining Vishnu.
mdu-koodal-azhagar.darshanInfo: Peaceful morning darshan; climb carefully along narrow stone steps.
mdu-koodal-azhagar.dressCode: Modest dress; shoulders and knees covered.

mdu-azhagar-kovil.name: Azhagar Kovil (Kallazhagar Temple)
mdu-azhagar-kovil.summary: Foothill fortress temple nestled in Alagar Hills, famed for fragrant chandanam prasadam.
mdu-azhagar-kovil.darshanInfo: Check morning darshan queue; Noopura Ganga spring nearby.
mdu-azhagar-kovil.dressCode: Modest attire; watch out for friendly hill monkeys near snacks.
mdu-azhagar-kovil.feeNote: Free general entry; hill shuttle extra (verify before launch).

mdu-pazhamudhircholai.name: Pazhamudhircholai Murugan Temple
mdu-pazhamudhircholai.summary: Forest-clad sixth abode of Murugan shaded by ancient jamun and neem trees.
mdu-pazhamudhircholai.darshanInfo: Continuous daytime darshan; short forest drive up from Azhagar Kovil.
mdu-pazhamudhircholai.dressCode: Modest casuals; comfortable walking footwear until temple steps.

mdu-thiruparankundram-hill.name: Thiruparankundram Hill Mountain View
mdu-thiruparankundram-hill.summary: Crisp 5:00 AM granite ridge walk overlooking Madurai's lakes and distant temple towers.
mdu-thiruparankundram-hill.darshanInfo: Open sunrise access; carry a flashlight before 5:45 AM.
mdu-thiruparankundram-hill.dressCode: Breathable walking wear and grip shoes.

mdu-busy-streets.name: Historic Masi Streets & Heritage Walk
mdu-busy-streets.summary: Madurai's concentric temple streets alive with jasmine garlands, brass bells, and cotton mills.
mdu-busy-streets.darshanInfo: Best on foot between 7:00–8:30 AM before midday traffic builds.
mdu-busy-streets.dressCode: Comfortable walking clothes and sun hat.

mdu-nayakkar-mahal.name: Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal
mdu-nayakkar-mahal.summary: 17th-century Indo-Saracenic palace with soaring 25-meter stucco pillars and grand courtyard.
mdu-nayakkar-mahal.darshanInfo: Tickets at main gate; morning light illuminates the colonnade beautifully.
mdu-nayakkar-mahal.feeNote: ₹50 Indian visitors; higher international rate applies (verify before launch).

mdu-kaikari-sandhai.name: Kaikari Sandhai (Vegetable Market)
mdu-kaikari-sandhai.summary: Bustling local farmers' market stacked with Madurai malli jasmine, bananas, and farm greens.
mdu-kaikari-sandhai.darshanInfo: Peak freshness 6:00–11:00 AM; bring small cash notes and cloth bag.

mdu-pandi-bazaar.name: Pandi Bazaar & Puthu Mandapam Crafts
mdu-pandi-bazaar.summary: Artisan lanes for Sungudi tie-dye cotton sarees, bronze lamps, and palm-leaf baskets.
mdu-pandi-bazaar.darshanInfo: Most shops open by 10:00 AM; direct support for local weavers.

mdu-teppakulam-food.name: Teppakulam Street Food & Jigarthanda
mdu-teppakulam-food.summary: Iconic Madurai evening stalls serving chilled Jigarthanda, kari dosai, and paruthi paal.
mdu-teppakulam-food.darshanInfo: Stalls peak after 6:30 PM along the tank promenade.
mdu-teppakulam-food.feeNote: Avg. ₹150 per person tasting (verify before launch).

mdu-vaigai-walk.name: Vaigai Riverfront & Kuruvithurai Trail
mdu-vaigai-walk.summary: Quiet dawn river path and historic check-dam along Madurai's legendary Sangam river.
mdu-vaigai-walk.darshanInfo: Best between 6:00–7:30 AM for golden mist and birdcalls.
mdu-vaigai-walk.dressCode: Light cotton wear and walking sandals.

mdu-samanar-hills.name: Samanar Malai (Jain Caves & Lotus Pond)
mdu-samanar-hills.summary: 2,000-year-old Tamil-Brahmi inscriptions, rock-cut Jain reliefs, and serene lotus pond.
mdu-samanar-hills.darshanInfo: Gentle 20-minute stone climb; visit before 9:30 AM sun.
mdu-samanar-hills.dressCode: Sneakers or strap sandals; carry drinking water.

mdu-kutladampatti-falls.name: Kutladampatti Waterfalls & Eco-Forest
mdu-kutladampatti-falls.summary: Seasonal cascade tucked in Sirumalai foothills, surrounded by tamarind and bamboo groves.
mdu-kutladampatti-falls.darshanInfo: Flow depends on monsoon season; morning ranger check-in required.
mdu-kutladampatti-falls.feeNote: Approx. ₹30 forest checkpost fee (verify before launch).

mdu-kaveri-vaigai-link.name: Madakulam & Nagamalai Birding Pond
mdu-kaveri-vaigai-link.summary: Tranquil irrigation tank inspired by Kaveri-Vaigai water wisdom, popular with painted storks.
mdu-kaveri-vaigai-link.darshanInfo: Golden hour 4:30–6:00 PM along the eastern bund.

mdu-gandhi-lawn.name: Gandhi Memorial Museum Courtyard
mdu-gandhi-lawn.summary: Shaded heritage lawns and historic palace complex (note: galleries closed on Fridays).

mdu-thiruparankundram-eve.name: Thiruparankundram Evening Ridge
mdu-thiruparankundram-eve.summary: Cool hill breeze as temple lamps flicker on below across Madurai's southern skyline.
mdu-thiruparankundram-eve.darshanInfo: Sunset around 6:10 PM; ideal unhurried pause.

mdu-teppakulam-eve.name: Vandiyur Teppakulam Evening Pond
mdu-teppakulam-eve.summary: Massive 17th-century stepped tank with central Maiya Mandapam glowing under evening lights.
mdu-teppakulam-eve.darshanInfo: Breezy promenade walks till 9:00 PM; optional paddle boating.

kmu-kasi-viswanathar.name: Kasi Viswanathar Temple
kmu-kasi-viswanathar.summary: Sacred Shiva shrine beside Mahamaham Tank housing the nine River Goddesses pavilion.
kmu-kasi-viswanathar.darshanInfo: Peaceful 6:00 AM dawn pooja; sacred tank steps right outside.
kmu-kasi-viswanathar.dressCode: Traditional or modest attire covering shoulders and knees.

kmu-someswarar.name: Someswarar & Adi Kumbeswarar Circuit
kmu-someswarar.summary: Twin architectural gems of Kumbakonam known for Chola stone pillars and nadaswaram melodies.
kmu-someswarar.darshanInfo: Morning darshan 6:00 AM–12:30 PM; calm weekday mornings.
kmu-someswarar.dressCode: Modest dress; footwear stand at main gateway.

kmu-sarangapani.name: Sarangapani Perumal Temple
kmu-sarangapani.summary: Towering 11-tier Raja Gopuram and chariot-shaped stone sanctum pulled by carved horses.
kmu-sarangapani.darshanInfo: Morning darshan till 12:30 PM; admire intricate dance karanas.

kmu-nageswaran.name: Nageswaran Solar Temple
kmu-nageswaran.summary: Early Chola masterpiece aligned so sunlight touches the Shiva Lingam during Chithirai.
kmu-nageswaran.darshanInfo: Evening opening 4:30 PM; quiet stone prakaram.

kmu-chakrapani.name: Chakrapani Temple
kmu-chakrapani.summary: Unique eight-armed Sudarshana Chakra shrine close to the Kaveri bathing ghat.

kmu-flower-market.name: Kumbakonam Morning Flower Market
kmu-flower-market.summary: Fragrant dawn market run largely by local women weaving jasmine, marigold, and lotus garlands.
kmu-flower-market.darshanInfo: Vibrant from 5:30–8:30 AM before garlands head to 12 town temples.

kmu-kaikari-market.name: Kumbakonam Kaikari Market
kmu-kaikari-market.summary: Cauvery delta farm market brimming with ash gourd, betel leaves, plantains, and curry leaves.
kmu-kaikari-market.darshanInfo: Lively morning trade; great insight into delta agriculture.

kmu-kaveri-pond.name: Chakrapani Padithurai (Kaveri River Pond)
kmu-kaveri-pond.summary: Tree-shaded river steps and tranquil sacred pond along a bend of the Cauvery.
kmu-kaveri-pond.darshanInfo: Calmest before 9:00 AM; respect local morning bathers.

kmu-mahamaham-tank.name: Mahamaham Tank & Brass Craft Lanes
kmu-mahamaham-tank.summary: Iconic 6-acre sacred tank ringed by 16 stone mandapams, flanked by traditional lamp makers.
kmu-mahamaham-tank.darshanInfo: Open all day; visit brass workshops in nearby Kammalar Street.
kmu-mahamaham-tank.dressCode: Casual attire; sun cap recommended mid-morning.

kmu-degree-coffee.name: Heritage Degree Coffee & Snack Stall
kmu-degree-coffee.summary: Frothed farm-milk filter coffee poured in gleaming brass dabara-tumbler sets.
kmu-degree-coffee.darshanInfo: Fresh evening batch around 4:30 PM alongside crispy bajji.

kmu-kaveri-arasalar.name: Arasalar & Kaveri Confluence Ghat
kmu-kaveri-arasalar.summary: Peaceful delta riverbank shaded by banyan roots where local fishermen launch coracles.

kmu-thirubuvanam-groves.name: Thirubuvanam Coconut Groves & Lotus Canal
kmu-thirubuvanam-groves.summary: Emerald paddy fields, irrigation canals, and handloom silk cottages east of Kumbakonam.
kmu-thirubuvanam-groves.darshanInfo: Morning bicycle or auto ride along quiet village bunds.

kmu-kallanai-day.name: Kallanai (Grand Anicut) Kaveri Regulator
kmu-kallanai-day.summary: 2,000-year-old Chola stone dam still diverting Kaveri waters across the fertile delta.
kmu-kallanai-day.darshanInfo: Approx. 1 hr scenic drive from Kumbakonam; best with full-day auto/cab.
kmu-kallanai-day.feeNote: Free park entry (verify local parking fee before launch).

kmu-kollidam-sunset.name: Kollidam River Sandbanks
kmu-kollidam-sunset.summary: Wide sandy riverbanks north of town where egrets gather in amber sunset light.
kmu-kollidam-sunset.darshanInfo: Stay near main bank; enjoy breeze from 5:00–6:15 PM.

kmu-darasuram.name: Airavatesvara Temple, Darasuram
kmu-darasuram.summary: UNESCO World Heritage Chola temple famed for musical stone steps and miniature friezes.
kmu-darasuram.darshanInfo: Golden afternoon light at 4:00 PM brings granite carvings alive.
kmu-darasuram.dressCode: Modest attire; barefoot inside stone mandapam.
kmu-darasuram.feeNote: ₹40 Indian / ₹600 foreign ASI monument fee (verify before launch).

kmu-swamimalai.name: Swamimalai Temple & Bronze Artisans
kmu-swamimalai.summary: Hilltop Murugan shrine paired with lost-wax Panchaloha bronze casting workshops below.
kmu-swamimalai.darshanInfo: 60 gentle stone steps; watch artisans shape clay moulds until 5:30 PM.

kmu-mahamaham-eve.name: Mahamaham Tank Evening Reflections
kmu-mahamaham-eve.summary: Quiet twilight stroll around the stone steps as gopurams reflect in calm temple waters.
kmu-mahamaham-eve.darshanInfo: Evening lamps lit around 6:30 PM; peaceful local atmosphere.

loc-mdu-artisan-1.bio: 28 women artisans preserving natural-dye Madurai Sungudi cotton dots without synthetic runoff.

loc-mdu-eatery-1.bio: Uses native palm jaggery, almond gum, and slow-simmered milk for authentic Madurai cooling drinks.

loc-mdu-driver-1.bio: Knows every one-way Masi street rule and best shoe-counter drop-off points around Madurai temples.

loc-kmu-guide-1.bio: Specializes in Darasuram friezes, Nageswaran solar alignments, and Kaveri cultural folklore.

loc-kmu-artisan-1.bio: Third-generation Sthapathi family shaping Kaveri clay moulds into heritage brass & bronze lamps.

loc-kmu-eatery-1.bio: Freshly roasted Chicory-Peaberry blend brewed in brass filters and served with banana-leaf snacks.

loc-kmu-driver-1.bio: Connects town temples seamlessly with Thirubuvanam coconut lanes and Swamimalai workshops.
